data.title: Pronouns — Starter · Lesson 3
data.subject: pronouns
data.lyrics:
"""
[Ad-lib]
¡Atención todos!

[Hook]
Let's celebrate… ¡Celebremos!
Balloons and cake… Globos y pastel.
It's your day… Es tu día
Have fun today… Diviértete hoy.
We sing and play… Cantamos y jugamos.

[Verse]
Friends are here… Los amigos están aquí.
Laughter everywhere… La risa está por doquier.
We (feminine)… nosotras, dancing in the sun.
You (plural, informal, Spain)… vosotros, having so much fun.
You (plural, formal/informal, Latin America)… ustedes, join the cheer.
They (feminine)… ellas, bring the cheer.

[Hook]
Let's celebrate… ¡Celebremos!
Balloons and cake… Globos y pastel.
It's your day… Es tu día
Have fun today… Diviértete hoy.
We sing and play… Cantamos y jugamos.

[Verse]
He… él, brings the gifts with a smile.
She… ella, dances all the while.
Us… nosotros, singing in the round.
You (plural, informal, Spain)… vosotros, the joy we have found.
To them… a ellos, we give a cheer.
Him/it… lo, we hold dear.

[Bridge]
I… yo, see you… te, in the light.
